context: Mature open-grown Oregon white oak (Quercus garryana) in savanna, pasture or parkland; single-stemmed, healthy, leaf-on; not a shrubby variety (var. breweri, var. semota), not a forest-grown stand tree.

required_capabilities.rationale: Capability assessment 2026-09-26 (host). The oak needs wood on every axis, a lobed blade and an alternate petiole, all expressed in crates/telperion-core/src/capability.rs; no unreachable traits assessed. See packet/capability.json.
